detail: A sampling scheme proposed by the authors that preserves rendering quality while significantly increasing runtime efficiency compared to Hierarchical Sampling [S1].

The claim states that the authors proposed a sampling scheme that preserves rendering quality while significantly increasing runtime efficiency compared to Hierarchical Sampling. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'We further trained our method and NeRF on a single sentence applying different sampling schemes: the hierarchical sampling (HS) in [23] and our simple sampling (SS)... As we can see our simple sampling preserves rendering quality while enjoying a large increase in runtime efficiency.' It further provides specific timing data (0.9s for NV vs >25s for NeRF, with the proposed method at 3.6s) to support the efficiency claim. Thus, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.
